rules.signs: The sign is freeform intent, not command slots. Ari may interpret metaphorically.
rules.walls: Walls block and delay ground enemies. Flying enemies ignore walls, so wall-only plans fail against wings.
rules.aura_orb: Aura Orb damages enemies inside its circle. It works best when Ari lures enemies through the light.
rules.tower: Bow towers give height and ranged attacks. Ranged attack requires an existing tower or tower preparation.
rules.training: Combat dummy and sword training improve fighting readiness before Ari risks direct contact.
rules.forge: Ore plus forge time can improve sword tier. Smithing is useful but costs day preparation time.
rules.farming: Food and eating reduce hunger pressure. Hunger can make every plan less safe.
rules.rest: Rest recovers HP, stamina, and fear when Ari has enough safety to spend time.
rules.library: Library reflection turns recent events into lessons and future priority bias.
rules.dawn: Night enemies clear at dawn. Surviving until morning can be correct when fighting is too risky.
rules.storm_rod: Storm Rod is the dedicated answer to flying enemies and sky threats.
rules.permanent_upgrades: Permanent upgrades help Ari survive but do not replace reading the current world.

affordance_notes.use_existing_wall: Use cover that already exists. Do not build more wall when the sign clearly means stand behind a current wall.
affordance_notes.build_wall: Build wall only when no usable cover exists or stronger cover is the intended preparation.
affordance_notes.wait_behind_wall: Hold safe position behind existing cover while danger approaches.
affordance_notes.use_cover: Use wall, tower, or other safe geometry to keep danger away.
affordance_notes.place_aura_orb: Build the light circle when Ari needs a kill zone and can afford it.
affordance_notes.lure_to_aura: Move so enemies cross the aura instead of fighting them directly.
affordance_notes.build_tower: Create ranged height when Ari has time and stone.
affordance_notes.use_tower: Use an existing tower for distance and ranged attacks.
affordance_notes.ranged_attack: Use ranged pressure from a tower or range-capable position.
affordance_notes.build_storm_rod: Build anti-flying support when wings or sky threats matter.
affordance_notes.anti_flying: Prefer storm rod or ranged answers over wall-only safety.
affordance_notes.sky_answer: Treat flying enemies as a separate tactical problem.
affordance_notes.mine_ore: Mine ore before smithing if Ari lacks ore.
affordance_notes.smith_sword: Improve sword only when there is enough ore and time.
affordance_notes.fight_head_on: Direct fighting is valid only when Ari is ready enough and not overwhelmed.
affordance_notes.stall_until_dawn: Delay until dawn when survival matters more than kills.
affordance_notes.hide_until_dawn: Use cover, distance, or towers to live until morning.
affordance_notes.farm_food: Make food before hunger becomes panic.
affordance_notes.eat_food: Eat stored food when hunger is dangerous.
affordance_notes.rest: Recover when Ari is safe enough to spend time.
affordance_notes.reflect_library: Use the library when the sign asks for learning or recent mistakes matter.
